description: This file contains styles for a navigation bar component in a React UI, defining styles for various elements such as the navbar, links, and menu toggle.

classes.name: navbar
classes.description: The main navigation bar container, styles include width, background color, text color, and shadow.

classes.name: brand
classes.description: Styles for the brand/logo section of the navbar, including font size and color.

classes.name: link
classes.description: Styles for navigation links, including hover and focus effects.

classes.name: menuToggle
classes.description: Styles for the button that toggles the mobile menu, including hover and focus states.

classes.name: mobileMenu
classes.description: Styles for the mobile navigation menu, which is displayed on smaller screens.

classes.name: spacer
classes.description: Provides spacing for fixed navbars to avoid overlap with content.
